SELECT
  tenant_id,
  supplier_id,
  countIf(settled AND submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)                         AS sent_1h,
  countIf(st = 'delivered' AND submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)                AS dlvd_1h,
  countIf(settled)                                                                     AS sent_24h,
  countIf(st = 'delivered')                                                            AS dlvd_24h,
  round(avgIf(dateDiff('millisecond', submitted_at, dat),
              st = 'delivered' AND dat > submitted_at), 0)                             AS avg_latency
FROM (
  SELECT m.tenant_id AS tenant_id, m.supplier_id AS supplier_id, m.submitted_at AS submitted_at,
         if(s.st != '', s.st, m.status) AS st,
         if(s.dat > m.delivered_at, s.dat, m.delivered_at) AS dat,
         (st NOT IN ('submitted', 'accepted', 'enroute', 'queued', '')
           OR m.submitted_at < now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS settled
  FROM messages AS m
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(status, version) AS st, argMax(delivered_at, version) AS dat
    FROM message_status
    WHERE version >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64() - INTERVAL 25 HOUR)
    GROUP BY tenant_id, id
  ) AS s ON s.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND s.id = m.id
  WHERE m.direction = 'mt'
    AND m.supplier_id != ''
    AND m.submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
)
GROUP BY tenant_id, supplier_id

SELECT mccmnc, country, network, ported, line_type, provider, toUnixTimestamp(created_at) AS at FROM lookup_events WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (msisdn = '966560595392') AND (status = 'ok') AND (mccmnc != '') AND (provider IN ('ss7', 'hlr', 'http', 'enum')) AND (created_at >= (now() - _CAST(86400, 'UInt32'))) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT region_id, kind, value FROM region_members WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (((kind = 'country') AND (value = 'Jordan')) OR ((kind = 'mccmnc') AND (value = '41601'))) GROUP BY region_id, kind, value HAVING argMax(is_deleted, updated_at) = 0

SELECT argMax(value, version) AS v, argMax(value_type, version) AS vt, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS del FROM settings WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (module = 'partner') AND (key = 'poller_enabled') GROUP BY tenant_id, module, key
SELECT id, argMax(data, version) AS data FROM asr_alert_thresholds WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY id HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT prefix, mccmnc, mcc, scope, toString(rate) AS rate, currency, kind, party_id, (is_deleted = 0) AND (active_till >= today()) AS live FROM rates WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (plan_id = 'customer:demo-cus-okapira') AND (effective_date <= today()) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1 BY tenant_id, plan_id, mccmnc, mcc, prefix

SELECT
  tenant_id,
  supplier_id,
  countIf(settled AND submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)                         AS sent_1h,
  countIf(st = 'delivered' AND submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR)                AS dlvd_1h,
  countIf(settled)                                                                     AS sent_24h,
  countIf(st = 'delivered')                                                            AS dlvd_24h,
  round(avgIf(dateDiff('millisecond', submitted_at, dat),
              st = 'delivered' AND dat > submitted_at), 0)                             AS avg_latency
FROM (
  SELECT m.tenant_id AS tenant_id, m.supplier_id AS supplier_id, m.submitted_at AS submitted_at,
         if(s.st != '', s.st, m.status) AS st,
         if(s.dat > m.delivered_at, s.dat, m.delivered_at) AS dat,
         (st NOT IN ('submitted', 'accepted', 'enroute', 'queued', '')
           OR m.submitted_at < now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS settled
  FROM messages AS m
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(status, version) AS st, argMax(delivered_at, version) AS dat
    FROM message_status
    WHERE version >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64() - INTERVAL 25 HOUR)
    GROUP BY tenant_id, id
  ) AS s ON s.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND s.id = m.id
  WHERE m.direction = 'mt'
    AND m.supplier_id != ''
    AND m.event_date >= today() - 1
    AND m.submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
)
GROUP BY tenant_id, supplier_id

SELECT region_id, kind, value FROM region_members WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND ((kind = 'country') AND (value = 'Thailand')) GROUP BY region_id, kind, value HAVING argMax(is_deleted, updated_at) = 0

SELECT id, argMax(subject, version) AS subject, argMax(body, version) AS body, argMax(recipients, version) AS recipients, argMax(account_type, version) AS account_type, argMax(scheduled_at, version) AS scheduled_at, argMax(status, version) AS status FROM service_notifications WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY id HAVING (argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0) AND (status = 'scheduled') AND (scheduled_at <= now64())

SELECT toString(sum(amount)) AS total FROM (SELECT id, argMax(amount, updated_at) AS amount, argMax(is_deleted, updated_at) AS del FROM payment_allocations WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (invoice_id = 'MDE-2026-00071') GROUP BY id HAVING del = 0)

SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data
FROM saved_reports
GROUP BY tenant_id, id
HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT country, concat(mcc, mnc) AS mccmnc, currency, count() AS message_count, sum(segment_count) AS segment_count, sum(client_charge) AS subtotal FROM (SELECT m.country AS country, m.mcc AS mcc, m.mnc AS mnc, m.currency AS currency, m.segment_count AS segment_count, m.client_charge AS client_charge, m.billing_event AS billing_event, if(s.st != '', s.st, m.status) AS final_status FROM messages AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, argMax(status, version) AS st FROM message_status WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (customer_id = 'demo-cus-tidalyx') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= _CAST(1790812800, 'DateTime(\'UTC\')')) AND (submitted_at < _CAST(1793491200, 'DateTime(\'UTC\')')))) GROUP BY id) AS s ON s.id = m.id WHERE (m.tenant_id = 'demo') AND (m.customer_id = 'demo-cus-tidalyx') AND (m.direction = 'mt') AND (m.submitted_at >= _CAST(1790812800, 'DateTime(\'UTC\')')) AND (m.submitted_at < _CAST(1793491200, 'DateTime(\'UTC\')'))) WHERE (final_status != 'rejected') AND ((billing_event = 'sent') OR ((billing_event IN ('attempts', 'any_dlr')) AND (final_status IN ('delivered', 'undeliverable', 'expired', 'deleted'))) OR (final_status = 'delivered')) GROUP BY country, mccmnc, currency ORDER BY subtotal DESC
SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM tenants WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data
FROM edr_export_jobs
GROUP BY tenant_id, id
HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT scope_id, avg(d_cnt) AS vol_avg, stddevPop(d_cnt) AS vol_std, avg(d_rev) AS rev_avg, stddevPop(d_rev) AS rev_std, avg(d_cost) AS cost_avg, stddevPop(d_cost) AS cost_std, avg(d_asr) AS asr_avg, stddevPop(d_asr) AS asr_std FROM (SELECT supplier_id AS scope_id, toDate(submitted_at) AS d, count() AS d_cnt, sum(client_charge) AS d_rev, sum(supplier_charge) AS d_cost, if(count() > 0, (countIf(status = 'delivered') / count()) * 100, 100) AS d_asr FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at < toStartOfHour(now())) AND (toHour(submitted_at) = toHour(now())) AND (supplier_id != '') GROUP BY scope_id, d) GROUP BY scope_id

SELECT m.id, m.customer_id, m.dest_addr, m.country, m.supplier_id, if(s.st != '', s.st, m.status) AS status, formatDateTime(m.submitted_at, '%H:%i:%S') AS at FROM messages AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, argMax(status, version) AS st FROM message_status WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= yesterday()) AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(1))) ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 8)) GROUP BY id) AS s ON m.id = s.id WHERE (m.tenant_id = 'demo') AND (m.event_date >= yesterday()) AND (m.id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= yesterday()) AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(1))) ORDER BY submitted_at DESC LIMIT 8)) ORDER BY m.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT scope_id, avg(d_cnt) AS vol_avg, stddevPop(d_cnt) AS vol_std, avg(d_rev) AS rev_avg, stddevPop(d_rev) AS rev_std, avg(d_cost) AS cost_avg, stddevPop(d_cost) AS cost_std, avg(d_asr) AS asr_avg, stddevPop(d_asr) AS asr_std FROM (SELECT customer_id AS scope_id, toDate(submitted_at) AS d, count() AS d_cnt, sum(client_charge) AS d_rev, sum(supplier_charge) AS d_cost, if(count() > 0, (countIf(status = 'delivered') / count()) * 100, 100) AS d_asr FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at < toStartOfHour(now())) AND (toHour(submitted_at) = toHour(now())) AND (customer_id != '') GROUP BY scope_id, d) GROUP BY scope_id

SELECT supplier_id AS scope_id, count() AS volume, sum(client_charge) AS revenue, sum(supplier_charge) AS cost, count() AS sent, countIf(status = 'delivered') AS dlvd FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalMinute(_CAST(60, 'UInt32')))) AND (supplier_id != '') GROUP BY supplier_id

SELECT countIf(if(s.st != '', s.st, m.status) = 'delivered'), count() FROM messages AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, argMax(status, version) AS st FROM message_status WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (event_date >= yesterday()) AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalMinute(60))))) GROUP BY id) AS s ON m.id = s.id WHERE (m.tenant_id = 'demo') AND (m.direction = 'mt') AND (m.event_date >= yesterday()) AND (m.submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalMinute(60)))

SELECT customer_id AS scope_id, count() AS volume, sum(client_charge) AS revenue, sum(supplier_charge) AS cost, count() AS sent, countIf(status = 'delivered') AS dlvd FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalMinute(_CAST(60, 'UInt32')))) AND (customer_id != '') GROUP BY customer_id

SELECT account_id, argMax(level, created_at) AS level FROM balance_alerts WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (created_at >= (now() - toIntervalSecond(_CAST(86400, 'UInt32')))) GROUP BY account_id HAVING level != 'recovered'

SELECT scope_id, avg(d_cnt) AS vol_avg, stddevPop(d_cnt) AS vol_std, avg(d_rev) AS rev_avg, stddevPop(d_rev) AS rev_std, avg(d_cost) AS cost_avg, stddevPop(d_cost) AS cost_std, avg(d_asr) AS asr_avg, stddevPop(d_asr) AS asr_std FROM (SELECT '' AS scope_id, toDate(submitted_at) AS d, count() AS d_cnt, sum(client_charge) AS d_rev, sum(supplier_charge) AS d_cost, if(count() > 0, (countIf(status = 'delivered') / count()) * 100, 100) AS d_asr FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at < toStartOfHour(now())) AND (toHour(submitted_at) = toHour(now())) GROUP BY scope_id, d) GROUP BY scope_id

SELECT toStartOfMinute(submitted_at) AS m, count() AS c
FROM messages
WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' AND submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

SELECT toStartOfHour(submitted_at) AS h, count() AS cnt
FROM messages
WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' AND submitted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
GROUP BY h ORDER BY h
SELECT count() FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalSecond(60)))

SELECT range_from, range_to, mccmnc, mcc, country, network, operator, lot, argMax(version, version) AS ver FROM number_ranges WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (active_from <= _CAST(20762, 'Date')) AND (active_till >= _CAST(20762, 'Date')) GROUP BY range_from, range_to, mccmnc, mcc, country, network, operator, lot HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT mccmnc, country, network, ported, line_type, provider, toUnixTimestamp(created_at) AS at FROM lookup_events WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (msisdn = '6281810228518') AND (status = 'ok') AND (mccmnc != '') AND (provider IN ('ss7', 'hlr', 'http', 'enum')) AND (event_date >= toDate(now() - _CAST(86400, 'UInt32'))) AND (created_at >= (now() - _CAST(86400, 'UInt32'))) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT event_date, count() AS c
FROM messages
WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' AND event_date >= today() - 14
GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date
SELECT countMerge(total) FROM cube_traffic_inner WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date = today())
SELECT round(sumMerge(revenue), 4) FROM cube_traffic_inner WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date = today())

SELECT m.id, m.direction, m.source_addr, m.dest_addr, m.country, concat(m.mcc, m.mnc) AS mccmnc, m.segment_count, if(s.eff_status != '', s.eff_status, m.status) AS status, m.supplier_id, m.routing_profile_id, m.customer_id, toString(m.client_charge), toString(m.supplier_charge), '' AS body_preview, formatDateTime(m.submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS sent_at FROM messages AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, argMax(status, version) AS eff_status, argMax(final_outcome, version) AS eff_outcome FROM message_status WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY id) AS s ON m.id = s.id WHERE m.tenant_id = 'demo' ORDER BY m.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 0, 50

SELECT '' AS scope_id, count() AS volume, sum(client_charge) AS revenue, sum(supplier_charge) AS cost, count() AS sent, countIf(status = 'delivered') AS dlvd FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalMinute(_CAST(60, 'UInt32')))) GROUP BY ''

SELECT toString(argMax(amount, updated_at)) AS amount, argMax(currency, updated_at) AS currency, argMax(customer_id, updated_at) AS customer_id, argMax(party_kind, updated_at) AS party_kind, argMax(status, updated_at) AS status FROM payments WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id = 'PMT-b2d93b5e3ef93ec3') GROUP BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id, dial_code, argMaxIf(mccmnc, v, del = 0) AS mccmnc, argMaxIf(mcc, v, del = 0) AS mcc, argMaxIf(country, v, del = 0) AS country, argMaxIf(network, v, del = 0) AS network, countIf(del = 0) AS live FROM (SELECT tenant_id, dial_code, mccmnc, argMax(mcc, version) AS mcc, argMax(country, version) AS country, argMax(network, version) AS network, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS del, max(version) AS v FROM dial_codes WHERE (dial_code != '') AND (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (dial_code = '15') GROUP BY tenant_id, dial_code, mccmnc) GROUP BY tenant_id, dial_code
SELECT count(), toString(sum(client_charge)) FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date = yesterday()) AND (submitted_at <= (now() - toIntervalDay(1)))

SELECT tenant_id, base_currency, quote_currency, toString(argMaxIf(rate, effective_date, (del = 0) AND (effective_date <= _CAST(20762, 'Date')))) AS rate, toString(maxIf(effective_date, (del = 0) AND (effective_date <= _CAST(20762, 'Date')))) AS eff, argMaxIf(source, effective_date, (del = 0) AND (effective_date <= _CAST(20762, 'Date'))) AS source, countIf((del = 0) AND (effective_date <= _CAST(20762, 'Date'))) AS live, toString(minIf(effective_date, (del = 0) AND (effective_date > _CAST(20762, 'Date')))) AS next_eff, countIf((del = 0) AND (effective_date > _CAST(20762, 'Date'))) AS upcoming FROM (SELECT tenant_id, base_currency, quote_currency, effective_date, argMax(rate, updated_at) AS rate, argMax(source, updated_at) AS source, argMax(is_deleted, updated_at) AS del FROM fx_rates WHERE 1 AND (tenant_id = 'demo') GROUP BY tenant_id, base_currency, quote_currency, effective_date) GROUP BY tenant_id, base_currency, quote_currency

SELECT scope_id, avg(d_cnt) AS vol_avg, stddevPop(d_cnt) AS vol_std, avg(d_rev) AS rev_avg, stddevPop(d_rev) AS rev_std, avg(d_cost) AS cost_avg, stddevPop(d_cost) AS cost_std, avg(d_asr) AS asr_avg, stddevPop(d_asr) AS asr_std FROM (SELECT supplier_id AS scope_id, toDate(submitted_at) AS d, count() AS d_cnt, sum(client_charge) AS d_rev, sum(supplier_charge) AS d_cost, if(count() > 0, (countIf(status = 'delivered') / count()) * 100, 100) AS d_asr FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (event_date >= toDate(now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at < toStartOfHour(now())) AND (toHour(submitted_at) = toHour(now())) AND (supplier_id != '') GROUP BY scope_id, d) GROUP BY scope_id

SELECT id, argMax(name, version), argMax(priority, version), argMax(action, version), argMax(direction, version), argMax(ani_mask, version), argMax(dnis_mask, version), argMax(content_regex, version), argMax(data_coding, version), argMax(ton, version), argMax(npi, version), argMax(esm_class, version), argMax(country, version), argMax(time_start, version), argMax(time_end, version), argMax(toString(valid_from), version), argMax(toString(valid_to), version), argMax(enabled, version), argMax(reason, version) FROM firewall_custom_rules WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY id HAVING (argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0) AND (argMax(enabled, version) = 1)

SELECT region_id, kind, value FROM region_members WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (((kind = 'country') AND (value = 'Thailand')) OR ((kind = 'mcc') AND (value = '520')) OR ((kind = 'mccmnc') AND (value = '52005'))) GROUP BY region_id, kind, value HAVING argMax(is_deleted, updated_at) = 0

SELECT scope_id, avg(d_cnt) AS vol_avg, stddevPop(d_cnt) AS vol_std, avg(d_rev) AS rev_avg, stddevPop(d_rev) AS rev_std, avg(d_cost) AS cost_avg, stddevPop(d_cost) AS cost_std, avg(d_asr) AS asr_avg, stddevPop(d_asr) AS asr_std FROM (SELECT customer_id AS scope_id, toDate(submitted_at) AS d, count() AS d_cnt, sum(client_charge) AS d_rev, sum(supplier_charge) AS d_cost, if(count() > 0, (countIf(status = 'delivered') / count()) * 100, 100) AS d_asr FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (event_date >= toDate(now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at < toStartOfHour(now())) AND (toHour(submitted_at) = toHour(now())) AND (customer_id != '') GROUP BY scope_id, d) GROUP BY scope_id

SELECT supplier_id, asr_24h AS asr, asr_1h AS dlr_pct, total_sent AS sent, 'active' AS status
FROM supplier_health_snapshots FINAL
WHERE tenant_id = 'demo'
ORDER BY sent DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT if(s.st != '', s.st, m.status) AS st_now, count() AS c FROM messages AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, argMax(status, version) AS st FROM message_status WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date = today()))) GROUP BY id) AS s ON m.id = s.id WHERE (m.tenant_id = 'demo') AND (m.event_date = today()) GROUP BY st_now ORDER BY c DESC

SELECT toUInt64(sum(segment_count)) AS vol FROM (SELECT m.segment_count AS segment_count, m.client_charge AS client_charge, m.currency AS currency, m.billing_event AS billing_event, if(s.st != '', s.st, m.status) AS final_status FROM messages AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, argMax(status, version) AS st FROM message_status WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (customer_id = 'demo-cus-tidalyx') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= _CAST(1790812800, 'DateTime')) AND (submitted_at < _CAST(1793491200, 'DateTime')))) GROUP BY id) AS s ON s.id = m.id WHERE (m.tenant_id = 'demo') AND (m.customer_id = 'demo-cus-tidalyx') AND (m.direction = 'mt') AND (m.submitted_at >= _CAST(1790812800, 'DateTime')) AND (m.submitted_at < _CAST(1793491200, 'DateTime'))) WHERE (final_status != 'rejected') AND ((billing_event = 'sent') OR ((billing_event IN ('attempts', 'any_dlr')) AND (final_status IN ('delivered', 'undeliverable', 'expired', 'deleted'))) OR (final_status = 'delivered'))

SELECT id, argMax(mccmnc, version), argMax(sender_pattern, version), argMax(content_class, version), argMax(expected_route, version), argMax(monetized, version), argMax(action_on_bypass, version) FROM route_classification WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY id HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT tenant_id, module, key, argMax(value, version) AS v, argMax(value_type, version) AS vt, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM settings WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, module, key

SELECT scope_id, avg(d_cnt) AS vol_avg, stddevPop(d_cnt) AS vol_std, avg(d_rev) AS rev_avg, stddevPop(d_rev) AS rev_std, avg(d_cost) AS cost_avg, stddevPop(d_cost) AS cost_std, avg(d_asr) AS asr_avg, stddevPop(d_asr) AS asr_std FROM (SELECT '' AS scope_id, toDate(submitted_at) AS d, count() AS d_cnt, sum(client_charge) AS d_rev, sum(supplier_charge) AS d_cost, if(count() > 0, (countIf(status = 'delivered') / count()) * 100, 100) AS d_asr FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (event_date >= toDate(now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at >= (now() - toIntervalDay(_CAST(7, 'UInt32')))) AND (submitted_at < toStartOfHour(now())) AND (toHour(submitted_at) = toHour(now())) GROUP BY scope_id, d) GROUP BY scope_id
SELECT area, perm FROM role_permissions WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (role = 'tenant_user') GROUP BY area, perm HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT id, argMax(sender_id, version), argMax(country, version), argMax(status, version) FROM sender_id_registry WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY id HAVING (argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0) AND (argMax(status, version) = 'approved')
SELECT tenant_id, system_id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM smpp_accounts WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, system_id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM carriers WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM tenants WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM routing_rules WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM sms_poi WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM agreements WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM omnichannel_templates WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT tenant_id, id, argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM accounts WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY tenant_id, id

SELECT tenant_id, id,
       argMax(msisdn, version), argMax(prefix, version),
       argMax(range_from, version), argMax(range_to, version),
       argMax(category, version), argMax(action, version)
FROM high_risk_numbers
GROUP BY tenant_id, id
HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT tenant_id, argMax(label, version_ts) AS label, argMax(source, version_ts) AS source, argMax(source_addr, version_ts), argMax(dest_addr, version_ts), argMax(country, version_ts), argMax(mccmnc, version_ts), argMax(content, version_ts), argMax(weight, version_ts) FROM (SELECT tenant_id, id, label, source, source_addr, dest_addr, country, mccmnc, content, weight, toUnixTimestamp(created_at) AS version_ts FROM fw_model_feedback WHERE tenant_id = 'demo') GROUP BY tenant_id, id LIMIT _CAST(20000, 'UInt32')
SELECT tenant_id, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM smpp_accounts WHERE system_id = 'dmmirabay' GROUP BY tenant_id

SELECT msg_channel, count() AS volume, countIf(eff_status IN ('delivered', 'read')) AS delivered, round(sum(charge), 4) AS revenue FROM (SELECT id, any(channel) AS msg_channel, argMax(status, (sent_at, indexOf(['submitted', 'delivered', 'read', 'failed', 'expired'], status))) AS eff_status, max(client_charge) AS charge FROM omnichannel_messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= (today() - 6)) AND (event_date <= today()) AND (channel != 'sms') GROUP BY id) GROUP BY msg_channel

WITH page AS (SELECT m.id, m.direction, m.source_addr, m.dest_addr, m.country, m.mcc, m.mnc, m.segment_count, m.status, m.supplier_id, m.routing_profile_id, m.customer_id, m.client_charge, m.supplier_charge, m.submitted_at FROM messages AS m WHERE (m.tenant_id = 'demo') AND (m.event_date >= (today() - 7)) ORDER BY m.submitted_at DESC LIMIT 0, 50) SELECT m.id, m.direction, m.source_addr, m.dest_addr, m.country, concat(m.mcc, m.mnc) AS mccmnc, m.segment_count, if(s.eff_status != '', s.eff_status, m.status) AS status, m.supplier_id, m.routing_profile_id, m.customer_id, toString(m.client_charge), toString(m.supplier_charge), '' AS body_preview, formatDateTime(m.submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS sent_at FROM page AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, argMax(status, version) AS eff_status, argMax(final_outcome, version) AS eff_outcome FROM message_status WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id IN (SELECT id FROM page)) GROUP BY id) AS s ON m.id = s.id ORDER BY m.submitted_at DESC
SELECT count() FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= (today() - 30))

SELECT round(sum(client_charge), 4) AS revenue,
       round(sum(supplier_charge), 4) AS cost
FROM messages
WHERE event_date >= today() - 30

SELECT if(supplier_id = '', '—', supplier_id) AS supplier_id, round(avgIf(dateDiff('millisecond', submitted_at, delivered_at), (status = 'delivered') AND (delivered_at > submitted_at)), 0) AS avg_latency FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= (today() - 6)) AND (event_date <= today()) AND (direction = 'mt') GROUP BY supplier_id

SELECT id, argMax(tenant_id, updated_at) AS tenant_id, argMax(customer_id, updated_at) AS customer_id, argMax(gateway, updated_at) AS gateway, argMax(gateway_ref, updated_at) AS gateway_ref, argMax(payment_id, updated_at) AS payment_id, toString(argMax(amount, updated_at)) AS amount, argMax(currency, updated_at) AS currency, argMax(status, updated_at) AS status, argMax(redirect_url, updated_at) AS redirect_url, argMax(error, updated_at) AS error, argMax(created_by, updated_at) AS created_by, toString(argMax(updated_at, updated_at)) AS upd_at, max(updated_at) AS _ord FROM (SELECT * FROM payment_gateway_txns WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id = 'PGW-9addcedbb8aa78d1')) GROUP BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT count() AS volume, countIf(status = 'delivered') AS delivered, round(sum(client_charge), 4) AS revenue FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= (today() - 6)) AND (event_date <= today())

SELECT DISTINCT msisdn FROM lookup_events WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (status = 'ok') AND (mccmnc != '') AND (provider IN _CAST(['ss7', 'hlr', 'http', 'enum'], 'Array(String)')) AND (event_date >= toDate(now() - _CAST(86400, 'UInt32'))) AND (created_at >= (now() - _CAST(86400, 'UInt32')))
SELECT argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM routing_rules WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id = 'demo-rt-tr-lcr') GROUP BY tenant_id, id
SELECT kind, value FROM region_members WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (region_id = 'demo-rg-levant') GROUP BY kind, value HAVING argMax(is_deleted, updated_at) = 0 ORDER BY kind ASC, value ASC

SELECT tenant_id, argMax(label, version_ts) AS label, argMax(source, version_ts) AS source, argMax(source_addr, version_ts), argMax(dest_addr, version_ts), argMax(country, version_ts), argMax(mccmnc, version_ts), argMax(content, version_ts), argMax(weight, version_ts) FROM (SELECT tenant_id, id, label, source, source_addr, dest_addr, country, mccmnc, content, weight, toUnixTimestamp(created_at) AS version_ts FROM fw_model_feedback) GROUP BY tenant_id, id LIMIT _CAST(20000, 'UInt32')

SELECT customer_id, count() AS n FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (direction = 'mt') AND (concat(mcc, mnc) = '60202') AND (event_date >= _CAST(20702, 'Date')) AND (event_date < _CAST(20722, 'Date')) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT argMax(data, version) AS data, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS deleted FROM suppliers WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id = 'demo-sup-tagovia') GROUP BY tenant_id, id

SELECT if(error_code = '', 'none', error_code) AS ec, count() AS c FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= (today() - 6)) AND (event_date <= today()) AND (status IN ('undeliverable', 'expired', 'rejected', 'deleted')) GROUP BY ec ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT argMax(sender_id, version), argMax(customer_id, version), argMax(country, version), argMax(mccmnc, version), argMax(type, version), argMax(status, version), argMax(registry, version), argMax(external_ref, version), argMax(approved_by, version), argMax(toString(valid_from), version), argMax(toString(valid_to), version) FROM sender_id_registry WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (id = 'demo-sid-qmbank-ae') GROUP BY tenant_id, id HAVING argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0

SELECT toDayOfWeek(submitted_at) AS dow, toHour(submitted_at) AS hour, count() AS c FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= (today() - 6)) AND (event_date <= today()) GROUP BY dow, hour

SELECT dest_addr, count() FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (dest_addr IN _CAST(['4916244892179', '27820778496', '213349549528', '447700900512', '4916031604321', '447595844274'], 'Array(String)')) GROUP BY 1

SELECT event_date, count() AS total, countIf(direction = 'mt') AS mt, countIf(direction = 'mo') AS mo, countIf(status = 'delivered') AS delivered, countIf(status IN ('undeliverable', 'expired', 'rejected', 'deleted')) AS failed FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= (today() - 6)) AND (event_date <= today()) GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date ASC

SELECT id, customer_id, supplier_id, source_addr, dest_addr, toUnixTimestamp(submitted_at), toUnixTimestamp(delivered_at), status, error_code, source_ip, data_coding FROM messages WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (event_date >= _CAST(20760, 'Date')) AND (direction = 'mt') AND (submitted_at >= toDateTime(_CAST(1793702169, 'UInt32'))) ORDER BY submitted_at >= toDateTime(_CAST(1793873769, 'UInt32')) DESC, cityHash64(id) ASC LIMIT _CAST(900, 'UInt32')

SELECT id, argMax(data, version) AS data FROM users WHERE tenant_id = 'murasil' GROUP BY id HAVING (argMax(is_deleted, version) = 0) AND (lowerUTF8(argMax(email, version)) = 'adiab@mccit.net') ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT round(sum(amount), 2) FROM (SELECT id, argMax(total_amount, version) AS amount, argMax(status, version) AS status, argMax(is_deleted, version) AS del FROM invoices WHERE tenant_id = 'demo' GROUP BY id HAVING (del = 0) AND (status NOT IN ('paid', 'void')))

SELECT toUnixTimestamp(logged_at) AS logged_ts, logged_us, direction, system_id, peer_ip, command_id, command_status, seq_num, session_id, pdu_hex FROM smpp_pdu_logs WHERE (tenant_id = 'demo') AND (logged_at >= toDateTime(_CAST(1793865728, 'Int64'))) ORDER BY logged_at DESC, logged_us DESC LIMIT _CAST(5000, 'UInt32')
